notes: cite.py --check 12.4.5.7.4 "the native alphanumeric collating sequence applies to any record keys of class alphanumeric" OK. When alphabet-name-1 is absent and no key-level clause names the key, `alphabet` stays null -> native ordinal (null weights). Probe p2 (only FOR NATIONAL written): the alphanumeric alternate key IX-ALT read A,M,Z (native); probe p5 (key-level on the prime only): IX-ALT A,M,Z native. No-clause files take the early return to native. No spec-derived test isolates this rule.
